concepts.name: Workbook Studio
concepts.description: A familiar ribbon, a spacious worksheet and report tabs along the bottom. Files and checks live in a task pane.

concepts.name: Review Inbox
concepts.description: Move through reports like an inbox. Folder navigation, a searchable report list and a large reading pane sit side by side.

concepts.name: Team Workspace
concepts.description: A compact app rail, report channels and a tabbed case workspace. Switch between overview, files, reports and mapping.

concepts.name: Fluent Desktop
concepts.description: A calm home screen with useful shortcuts, Windows-style navigation and dedicated pages for each part of the conversion.

concepts.name: Insights Desk
concepts.description: Reconciliation takes the main canvas. Switch to report data while keeping the file, mapping and report panes close at hand.
concepts.structure: Mode rail + report canvas + data pane
